from https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/563
> **NOTE:** this endpoint is not part of fulu release and is only required for gloas, it cannot be relied upon before that as clients might not have implemented it.

emphasis original

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: definitely can't be relied on pre-gloas, but if they have a flag to disable, it might be fine? operators should notice quite quickly if the vc cannot get duties, for now we should ensure that at least beacon nodes support `getProposerDutiesV2` and `head_v2`
